hub.title: Peer-to-peer webtools, armed with nostr.
hub.lead: Every tool here runs entirely in your browser and syncs over relays you choose. No sign-up needed, no server of ours, no tracking — and encryption happens before anything leaves your device.
hub.accountText: One account for every tool here. Your boards, files and chats follow you to every device you sign in on; without an account they stay on this device.
hub.accountSigned: Every tool here uses this account. Boards you made on this device before signing in are carried over.
hub.loadout.text: Grocery lists, to-dos, household inventory and markdown notes that sync between all your devices and whoever you share them with — rentry-style links, end-to-end encrypted. Works offline, and your devices put back whatever the relays forget.
hub.payload.text: Send files straight to another browser while you’re both online. Direct WebRTC when possible, encrypted through a relay otherwise, every 64 KB piece checked with SHA-256.
hub.pongjs.text: Retro two-player Pong between two browsers. Share a link or QR code or pick an open game, then play over a direct connection.
hub.enigmajs.text: Encrypted group chat rooms that vanish when the room closes. Share a code or QR and talk.
hub.devboard.text: A freelancer noticeboard: post that you’re hiring or available, signed with your key and backed by proof of work, voted on by peers, gone when it expires.
hub.relaysText: Loadout and DevBoard sync over these nostr relays; pick your own in the settings. Payload and pongjs still signal through public gun relays until they move to nostr too. Relays pass data along; they can’t read anything that was encrypted first.
hub.footer: Free software under the GPL — see the repository.
settings.title: Settings
settings.deviceText: Chosen here, used by every tool. With an account they follow you to your other devices.
settings.appsText: Hide the tools you don’t use; they disappear from the start page on every device signed in as you.
settings.backupText: One file with your key and everything your devices know: boards, settings, your account. Encrypted with a passphrase, it restores everything even if every relay forgot you.
settings.deviceCardText: Wiping removes your key and all cached data from this browser. Without an account, an exported key or a backup, whatever only this device had is lost.
settings.wipeConfirm: Delete this device’s key and all cached data?
settings.blockedText: People on this list can’t message you, can’t add you as a friend, and their posts stay out of your feeds. The list is encrypted; only your devices can read it.
settings.blockAdd: Block someone by their public key
settings.blockInvalid: That is not a public key (npub1… or 64 hex characters).
hub.cta: Everything you make here lives under a key that exists only in this browser. Create an account or sign in to use your boards, files and chats on every device.
